newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu appoints top adviser as U.N. ambassador.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu appoints top adviser as U.N. ambassador.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has appointed his top political adviser as Israel's ambassador to the United Nations, a spokesman said on Wednesday.
He said Dore Gold would take up the post very soon. Israel has been without a U.N. ambassador for nearly a year.

Israeli media have been rife with reports of a diplomatic shuffle that would include changing envoys to Washington but Israel's current ambassador, Eliyahu Ben-Elissar, told reporters in Israel on Wednesday he would remain in his post.
Netanyahu's spokesman said Uzi Arad, head of research in Israel's Mossad secret service, would take over from Gold as the prime minister's political adviser.
